summary: Lets front-desk staff find an open slot with the right provider and book a visit while checking insurance eligibility at the same time.
Automatically offers a canceled appointment slot to the next eligible patient on the waitlist, filling gaps in the provider's schedule.
Lets patients book, reschedule, or cancel their own appointments online without calling the clinic during business hours.
Flags appointments at high risk of a no-show based on patient history, prompting extra reminder calls for those visits.
Keeps a shared provider's calendar consistent across multiple clinic locations so a patient can't be double-booked at two sites.
Runs the encrypted video call between patient and provider for a scheduled telehealth visit, with screen sharing for reviewing images or results.
Holds patients in a virtual waiting room before their telehealth visit starts, showing the provider a queue of who has checked in.
Lets a provider send a prescription to the patient's preferred pharmacy directly from the telehealth visit screen.
Tests a patient's camera, microphone, and connection before a scheduled telehealth visit to reduce technical issues once the call starts.
Captures and stores a patient's consent before a telehealth session is recorded, attaching the consent record to the visit note.
Gives clinicians a fast, read-only view of a patient's full chart, including visit history, medications, and recent labs, before an appointment.
Lets clinicians add, resolve, and reorder a patient's active problem list, keeping it accurate across every provider who treats them.
Maintains a patient's documented allergies and reactions, surfacing a hard alert if a new order conflicts with a known allergy.
Syncs a patient's immunization records with the state registry so vaccination history stays current regardless of where a dose was given.
Records every view and edit made to a patient's chart, giving compliance staff a complete access trail for audit requests.
Verifies a patient's insurance eligibility and copay amount before their visit, reducing claim denials caused by coverage lapses.
Checks outgoing insurance claims for coding errors and missing fields before submission, cutting the first-pass denial rate.
Tracks denied claims through the appeal process, showing billing staff each denial reason and the deadline to respond.
Tracks prior authorization requests from submission to payer decision, alerting staff before a scheduled procedure loses its authorization window.
Generates a plain-language patient billing statement after insurance has paid its portion, showing what's owed and how to pay it.
Tracks a referral from the originating provider to the specialist's office, confirming the appointment was scheduled and the loop was closed.
Maintains a shared care plan for patients with chronic conditions, visible to every provider involved in their treatment.
Walks a discharge nurse through required education, medication reconciliation, and follow-up scheduling before a patient leaves the hospital.
Gives case managers a caseload view of high-risk patients with flags for overdue follow-ups or missing care plan updates.
Notifies a patient's primary care provider within hours of an emergency room visit or hospital admission so follow-up can be arranged quickly.
Lets prescribers send new prescriptions electronically to a patient's pharmacy of choice, checking formulary coverage before submission.
Screens a new prescription against a patient's current medication list for dangerous drug interactions before it's finalized.
Sends patients a reminder a few days before a maintenance medication is due for refill, with a one-tap request to their pharmacy.
Compares a patient's home medication list against what's ordered during a hospital stay, flagging discrepancies for a pharmacist to resolve.
Tracks refill patterns to estimate how consistently a patient is taking a prescribed medication and alerts the care team to gaps.
Ingests readings from a patient's home blood pressure cuff, glucose meter, or scale and attaches them to their chart automatically.
Alerts a care team member the moment a monitored patient's vitals cross an out-of-range threshold set by their care plan.
Charts a remote patient's vitals over weeks or months so a provider can spot a slow decline that a single reading wouldn't reveal.
Routes a critical remote monitoring alert to an on-call nurse if the primary care team doesn't acknowledge it within a set time window.
Lets patients see their own recorded vitals over time and log symptoms alongside the readings for their care team to review.
Lets clinical leadership build standardized order sets for common conditions, keeping ordering consistent with the latest care protocol.
Calculates a weight- and kidney-function-adjusted dose for a selected medication, reducing manual dosing math at the bedside.
Continuously scores inpatient vitals and labs for early sepsis risk, paging the bedside nurse when a patient crosses the alert threshold.
Lets a clinician search current treatment guidelines for a diagnosis directly from the chart without leaving the patient encounter.
Suggests a ranked list of possible diagnoses based on entered symptoms and history, intended as a second opinion rather than a final answer.
Gives patients a secure inbox to message their care team a non-urgent question and receive a reply within the practice's committed window.
Sends automated text and email reminders ahead of an upcoming appointment, with a link to confirm, reschedule, or cancel.
Notifies a patient when a new lab result is ready to view in their portal, holding sensitive results until a provider has reviewed them.
Sends patients a notice when a new balance is due and links directly to the online bill pay portal to settle it.
Lets a clinic send a single broadcast message, such as a weather closure notice, to every patient with an upcoming appointment.
Delivers completed lab results from the reference lab directly into the ordering provider's chart, ready for review and sign-off.
Pages the ordering provider immediately when a lab result comes back at a critical value requiring urgent action.
Shows a clinic staff member the status of a pending lab order, from specimen collection through result posting, without calling the lab.
Graphs a patient's results for a given lab value over time, making it easy to spot a trend across multiple visits at a glance.
Tracks a physical specimen from collection through transport to the lab, flagging any that exceed the expected transit time.
Lets patients search for an in-network provider by specialty, location, and language spoken, and view accepted insurance plans.
Verifies a provider's license, board certification, and malpractice history during credentialing and on a recurring renewal schedule.
Lets a patient confirm whether a specific provider is in-network for their exact insurance plan before booking a visit.
Keeps each clinic location's listed hours and services in sync across the directory, the website, and mapping services.
Collects verified patient satisfaction ratings after a visit and displays an aggregated score on the provider's directory profile.
Checks a patient's insurance eligibility against the payer in real time during check-in, catching lapsed coverage before service is rendered.
Shows front-desk staff a plain-language summary of a patient's deductible, copay, and coinsurance for the visit type being scheduled.
Determines which of a patient's two insurance plans should be billed first when they have overlapping coverage.
Keeps a historical record of a patient's insurance coverage changes over time, useful for resolving retroactive billing disputes.
Notifies billing staff when a returning patient's insurance plan has changed since their last visit so registration can update records upfront.
